searchText: MSRP $108,376. 2026 Brinkley Model Z Air 310 is approximately 37' 10' in length with 3 slides. Features Theater Seats Fireplace King Bed 2nd A/C Sliding Desk Dinette Table Integrity Package Power Package Insulation Package More About This RV You will love all the space and features in this travel trailer! A luxurious rear living room offers plenty of room to spread out, with a 72' tri-fold sofa plus theater seats, all arranged with a perfect view of the 42' TV over the fireplace. A central kitchen area includes an island with hidden pet bowls. Find even more storage with the hutch plus pantry with adjustable shelves. The front bedroom comes with a queen bed, but if you'd like you can upgrade to a king for even more room. No matter which you choose, you will enjoy watching the 32' bedroom TV. The full-width wardrobe has room for all of your clothes and also includes prep for an optional washer and dryer. And the full bath includes a 30' x 42' one-piece fiberglass shower. Outside you'll enjoy two awnings, pass-through storage, and LED ground lighting. With any Model Z Air travel trailer by Brinkley, you will enjoy premium features at every turn. The industry-first low maintenance roof is sure to be appreciated, plus there are industry-first brass plumbing connections for excellent resistance to corrosion. The drop-frame chassis with a massive pass-through bay will allow you to bring along camp gear galore, plus there are motion lighting and power outlets for added convenience! You'll also find two hot/cold showers outdoors, along with a 370-watt solar panel and a premium utility center with a retractable 65' water hose to wash off mud from the lake. The interior is just as accommodating with its solid surface countertops, Brinkley CraftSense wood trim construction, integrated blackout window shades, and the list of luxury features goes on!
